fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Single-Diode (De Soto) + Lambert-W I-V + Thermal ODE
source: De Soto, Klein & Beckman (2006) Solar Energy 80(1) 78-88; Jain & Kapoor (2004) Sol. Energy Mater. Sol. Cells 81(2) 269-277 (Lambert-W I-V); Faiman (2008) Prog. Photovolt. 16(4) 307-315; Jordan & Kurtz (2013) Prog. Photovolt. 21(1) 12-29; Green et al. (2019) Prog. Photovolt. 27(1); Solar Frontier SF170-S datasheet

unit.name: Solar Frontier SF170-S (CIGS thin-film, ~170 W) — Physics-Lumped

gamma_pmp.note: Power tempco -0.31 %/K for CIGS; lower magnitude than poly-Si (-0.39 %/K), reflecting low-temp-coefficient advantage

R_sh_ref.note: Shunt resistance at STC; scales as G_ref/G

a_ref.note: Modified ideality factor a = n*Ns*k*T/q at STC

EgRef.note: CIGS bandgap at STC; tunable 1.0-1.7 eV via Ga/(In+Ga) ratio (CuInSe2 ~1.0 eV -> CuGaSe2 ~1.7 eV)

thermal_mass.note: Areal heat capacity of glass/CIGS/glass laminate (~ Cglass*t); Jones & Underwood (2001) typical 11-13 kJ/m2K

valid_ranges.note: STC = 1000 W/m2, 25 degC cell. Efficiency physically bounded 0 < eff < 0.21 (lab CIGS record ~23.4%; commercial module ~14-16%).
